aboutPreview.text1: IVC Nexus is an audiovisual production and integrated communication agency founded in Ouagadougou, Burkina Faso. Our mission: giving every organization the visual and strategic tools to stand out, convince and leave a mark.
aboutPreview.text2: From concept to distribution, we support companies, institutions and NGOs in building a strong, consistent and impactful image — locally and internationally.

aboutPage.title: About IVC Nexus
aboutPage.historyText: IVC Nexus was born in Ouagadougou from a simple conviction: every organization, whatever its size, deserves an image worthy of its ambition. Since our beginnings, we have supported companies, institutions and NGOs in creating content that leaves a lasting mark on their audience.

faqPage.title: Frequently asked questions
faqPage.subtitle: Answers to the questions we're asked most often.

items.a: It depends on the service: a few days for a simple graphic design piece, several weeks for a full video production. A precise timeline is always included in the quote.
Every project is unique: pricing depends on the service, complexity and desired timeline. We provide a detailed, free quote after an initial conversation.

items.q: How do I request a quote?
items.a: Use the quote request form on the Contact page, specifying the service, preferred date and a description of your project. We reply within 48 business hours.

items.q: How do I book a service?
items.a: Use the "Book this service" button on the Services page, or contact us directly to check our availability.
We mainly work in Ouagadougou and surrounding areas. Travel to other regions or countries is possible depending on the project, to be discussed together.

items.q: What payment methods do you accept?
items.a: Payment terms (deposit, installments, accepted methods) are specified in each quote and adapted to the nature of the project.

items.q: Can I request changes after delivery?
items.a: A number of revisions is included depending on the service (see the Services page). Further adjustments may require an additional quote.
